description: Main class for creating and rendering graphs in the Image_Graph package, managing canvas output, coordinates, and error handling.

classes.name: Image_Graph
classes.description: Main class for graph creation, managing canvas, output, and error handling.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates instances of graph-related classes based on class name or alias.

methods.name: layoutFactory
methods.description: Creates layout objects ('Horizontal' or 'Vertical') with two parts and a split percentage.

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Creates a horizontal layout with two elements.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Creates a vertical layout with two elements.

methods.name: _default_error_handler
methods.description: Handles PHP errors and logs them.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Outputs the graph using the canvas, handling final rendering and saving.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of the graph to the output.
